The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, allowing the narrative to shift between different members of a space expedition team. This structural choice facilitates a dynamic range of perspectives, specifically contrasting the optimistic and curious voice of the scientist with the pragmatic and cautious tone of the engineer. The narrative style is characterized by a dualistic use of language: it utilizes technical terminology when describing machinery and phenomena, but transitions into a more reflective and philosophical mode when the characters contemplate their existence and place in the universe.

The part of a tree that grows underground is the root.
